prompts: Create a refined editorial illustration for a portfolio, wide aspect ratio 2.4:1. Reference 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY and winter outfit ONLY, discard its giant centered portrait composition. Reference 2 is the governing ART STYLE: charming tangible miniature object, refined geometric gouache, chunky simple silhouette, broad flat color planes, gentle matte paper pigment texture, slightly handmade cut-paper edges, flattened pictorial space. Substantial clean shapes, NO watercolor washes or torn-paper collage, no glossy 3D or realistic lighting. Subject: ONE beautifully designed powder-blue DESKTOP COMPUTER MONITOR with a visible thick blue bezel, short central stand and tiny base, front view with a subtle side plane. Whole monitor occupies the RIGHT 66% of the canvas, centered at x=66%, all of it inside x=32%-97%, y=9%-87%. LEFT 29% is completely empty warm ivory #f6f4ed, for website typography. Same warm ivory background everywhere, no border. On monitor: a virtual streamer broadcast. Screen's main content is a charming flat paper illustrated nighttime game landscape: blue rolling hills, tiny cream castle and crescent moon, a restrained ivory bar along top with coral status dot. CRITICAL: The user's Rem avatar occupies only the LOWER RIGHT CORNER INSIDE THE MONITOR SCREEN, as a conventional VTuber OVERLAY, about 27% of screen width and 53% of screen height. Complete hair silhouette and shoulders visible in the screen, her bottom cropped by screen lower edge. Keep the exact identifiable hair/face design from reference 1: blue bob covering viewer-left eye, one blue eye, white flower headband and pink crossed hair clips, powder-blue coat and ivory scarf. Render head slightly simplified in gouache to belong to style, but NOT chibi, no new character. Avatar is SMALL relative to computer, not centered, not a large external portrait. A couple of tiny blank chat bubbles inside left side of screen. Still illustration, not animated. No hands or human operator. Minimal set, no plants or room. No legible text, letters, numbers, branding, logos, watermark. Crisp substantial blue / cream / dusty coral shapes, sophisticated miniature gouache icon enlarged as an editorial composition. Preserve complete computer with sufficient margin for a slanted bottom crop.

Create a single compact horizontal editorial vignette, aspect ratio 3:1, for the AI VOICE module of a personal research portfolio. Use supplied reference solely for visual language: charming tangible miniature objects, refined geometric gouache, chunky simple silhouettes, broad flat color planes, gentle matte paper pigment texture, slightly handmade cut-paper edges, flattened pictorial space. NO realistic studio, recording microphone, operator, glossy 3D, soft watercolor landscape, abstract tech network, neon, or photorealistic effects. Depict AI-generated voice as a delightful physical-looking miniature AUDIO PLAYER on a quiet sage green backdrop #becaa9: one substantial warm ivory wide player with a powder-blue side edge, dark-sage waveform along its front and one coral round play button. At its left, two overlapping warm ivory speech cards with short dark-sage placeholder strokes, suggesting text supplied to synthesis; at its right, a small powder-blue loudspeaker emits two broad ivory voice arcs. A pair of soft powder-blue headphones rests around the right edge of the player, with headband and two obvious ear cups. A small rounded portrait badge on the player contains a simple blue bob-haired anime girl's face with one eye covered, a white flower hairband and tiny pink clip, recognizable Rem identity, NOT a large main character. One cohesive scene of listening to generated character speech, not a labeled diagram or flowchart. Compose the WHOLE object cluster inside central x=12%-89%, y=18%-82%, complete silhouette with comfortable empty background on all sides to allow website diagonal clipping. Left text cards, central audio player, right speaker form ONE tightly interlocking substantial sculptural arrangement, not an array of tiny floating icons. Restrained powder blue, warm ivory, sage and a tiny coral accent. Background uniform sage with extremely subtle fine pigment grain, no table horizon, no floating confetti or shadows. No text, letters, digits, musical notes, logos or watermark. It should feel like a handcrafted gouache miniature from the supplied reference, with confidently simple broad surfaces and rich blue silhouettes.
